AI-Native Software Engineer - Early Career

Location: Remote — global applications welcome; please apply via the region closest to you

Company: ChainGPT

Type: Full-Time

About ChainGPT

ChainGPT is a fast-moving Web3 and AI company building products at the intersection of blockchain infrastructure, token ecosystems, and intelligent automation. We value speed, ownership, clarity, and high standards. Our team is made up of self-driven operators who move fast, think independently, and use cutting-edge tools to create real commercial impact.

We're looking for an exceptional early-career engineer who has grown up building with AI.

You may be fresh out of university, still studying, or entirely self-taught. What matters most is raw ability, curiosity, strong technical instincts, and a genuine obsession with modern AI tooling.

This is a high-growth role for someone who wants to learn how a company is built from the inside while contributing to real product work from day one. What You'll Do

  • Build real features, prototypes, and demos using tools like Codex, Claude Code, and modern AI coding agents
  • Turn ideas into working demos quickly, then help make them more reliable, scalable, and production-ready
  • Learn how to direct, evaluate, and control AI coding agents to multiply engineering output
  • Work closely with founders and senior engineers across product, engineering, and strategy
  • Explore new AI development workflows and help the team move faster
  • Contribute to a fast-moving product where experimentation, speed, and quality all matter

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • You build with AI tools regularly and can show us what you've made
  • You have examples of projects, repos, demos, prototypes, or technical experiments
  • You're excited about tools like Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, AI agents, and agentic development workflows
  • You learn by building and ship constantly
  • You have strong technical curiosity and are willing to figure things out independently
  • You care more about output and learning speed than titles or credentials
  • You're comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with real responsibility

Bonus Points

  • You've created content, demos, or tutorials around AI or software development
  • You've tried to start something of your own
  • You have a side project you're deeply interested in
  • You've experimented with AI agents, coding workflows, automations, or developer tools
  • You're interested in AI infrastructure, enterprise AI, governance, or agentic systems

Why Join Us

  • Front-row seat: Learn how a company is built directly from founders and senior engineers
  • Real responsibility: You'll work on meaningful projects, not just small tasks
  • Strong mentorship: You'll be supported while being pushed to grow quickly
  • Frontier work: Build in one of the most exciting categories in tech right now
  • Output-first culture: We care about what you can build, learn, and ship

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Work alongside the ChainGPT core team on high-impact AI and Web3 products across our ecosystem
  • Remote-first setup with flexible hours, focused on outcomes, trust, and ownership
  • Competitive compensation, with performance-based upside where applicable to the role
  • Fast-moving environment with direct collaboration across all team members, including senior management, and clear accountability with no micromanagement
  • The support to do your best work, including the tools you need, structured onboarding, and clear room to grow

Company Culture And Values

At ChainGPT, we value Trust, Effective Speed, Innovation, and Growth. As our AI-Native Software Engineer - Early Career, you will embody these core values and have the opportunity to contribute to our culture and help drive our success. Join us on this exciting journey as we shape the future of blockchain and crypto technology.

Additional Information:

  • Employment Compliance and Confidentiality:

This process ensures compliance, protects company information, and establishes a secure and professional employment relationship
  • Employment Structure:
  • The position is offered on either an employee or contractor basis, depending on the location and role. Individuals will receive payment via direct deposit on a monthly basis. Additional details regarding compensation, benefits, and company policies will be provided during onboarding and outlined in the official employment agreement
  • Compensation:
  • Salaries are paid in fiat currency via direct deposit on a monthly schedule, with payments issued on the first business day of each month. This structure ensures timely and transparent compensation aligned with local financial systems
  • Probationary Period:
  • All new employees will undergo a 90-day probationary period, which serves as a mutual evaluation phase. During this time, both the employee and ChainGPT can assess fit, performance, and long-term alignment with the role and company

About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Develop AI-Powered Features

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Automated guest communication across channels
  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys
  • Operational forecasting

• Rabat
  • Publié il y a 5 mois

RED TIC recrute pour l’un de ses partenaires un profil INGENIEUR IA GENERATIVE & AGENTS IA.

Mission

Dans le cadre du développement de solutions d’Intelligence Artificielle Générative, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur IA Générative & Agents IA capable de concevoir, développer et industrialiser des assistants intelligents et des architectures multi-agents intégrées aux systèmes d’entreprise.

Le poste couvre l’ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions IA : conception d’assistants conversationnels, mise en place d’architectures RAG avancées, orchestration d’agents autonomes, intégration SI, optimisation des modèles et industrialisation des pipelines IA.

Responsabilités principales

  • Conception et développement d’assistants IA

Concevoir des assistants conversationnels avancés : chatbots, copilots, knowledge assistants.

Développer des prompts complexes, prompt chains et comportements multi-tours.

Implémenter des architectures RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) permettant la recherche contextuelle dans des bases documentaires, connaissances métier et données internes.

Intégrer des capacités de reasoning, planification et exécution de tâches via des agents autonomes.

Participer à la conception d’expériences conversationnelles robustes et sécurisées.

  • Mise en place et orchestration d’agents IA

Développer des agents spécialisés : search agent, planning agent, action agent, orchestrator agent.

Orchestrer Plusieurs Agents Via Des Frameworks Modernes

  • LangGraph
  • CrewAI
  • AutoGen
  • Semantic Kernel
  • MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Définir Les Stratégies De Coordination

  • délégation,
  • réflexion,
  • boucles de vérification,
  • validation des réponses.
  • Assurer la gestion des workflows, state machines et de la persistance du contexte conversationnel.
  • Intégration dans les systèmes d’entreprise

Concevoir et développer les API nécessaires aux services IA (REST, GraphQL, gRPC).

Intégrer Les Assistants Et Agents IA Avec

  • ERP,
  • CRM,
  • outils Data & IA,
  • services cloud.

Connecter les solutions IA aux bases vectorielles et datastores :

  • Pinecone,
  • Qdrant,
  • ChromaDB,
  • Redis Vector Search.

Participer à L’industrialisation Des Pipelines MLOps

  • Azure ML,
  • SageMaker,
  • Databricks.
  • Développement autour du RAG et du Knowledge Assistant

Développer Des Pipelines D’ingestion Documentaire

  • PDF,
  • sites web,
  • bases documentaires,
  • données métiers.

Mettre En Œuvre

  • chunking intelligent,
  • génération d’embeddings,
  • indexation vectorielle,
  • modèles de re-ranking.

Concevoir Des Assistants “enterprise-grade”

  • assistants Q&A métier,
  • assistants décisionnels,
  • copilotes internes.
  • Optimisation et gouvernance des modèles IA

Participer à L’optimisation Des Performances Des LLMs

  • instruction tuning,
  • fine-tuning (LoRA),
  • quantification,
  • distillation,
  • compression de modèles.
  • Mettre en place des mécanismes d’évaluation continue :
  • détection d’hallucinations,
  • qualité des réponses,
  • sécurité et conformité.
  • Assurer le monitoring et l’observabilité des applications IA.
  • Compétences techniques requises
  • LLMs & Agents

Maîtrise Des LLMs

  • OpenAI,
  • Azure OpenAI,
  • Anthropic,
  • Mistral,
  • Llama.

Expérience Des Frameworks D’orchestration

  • LangGraph,
  • AutoGen,
  • CrewAI,
  • Semantic Kernel,
  • MCP.
  • Connaissances en fine-tuning, LoRA et instruction tuning.

Expérience Des Plateformes IA Microsoft Et Google

  • Azure AI,
  • Copilot Studio,
  • Vertex AI,
  • Gemini Enterprise.
  • RAG & Search augmentée

Maîtrise Des Architectures RAG Avancées

  • contextual RAG,
  • hierarchical RAG,
  • multi-vector RAG.

Expérience Avec Les Vector Stores

  • Pinecone,
  • Qdrant,
  • Weaviate,
  • ChromaDB.
  • Optimisation de la recherche sémantique et des mécanismes de re-ranking.
  • Développement logiciel

Excellente Maîtrise De

  • Python,
  • TypeScript / Node.js.

Expérience Avec

  • LangChain,
  • LlamaIndex,
  • HuggingFace.

Développement D’API

  • REST,
  • GraphQL,
  • Webhooks.

Bonnes Pratiques DevOps

  • Git,
  • GitHub Actions,
  • CI/CD.
  • MLOps & Déploiement

Expérience Des Environnements Cloud Et MLOps

  • Azure ML,
  • Terraform,
  • Databricks.

Outils De Monitoring Et Observabilité

  • LangSmith,
  • Honeycomb,
  • OpenTelemetry.
  • Data Engineering & Manipulation documentaire
  • Mise en place de pipelines documentaires.
  • Nettoyage, transformation et structuration des données.
  • Gestion du stockage documentaire et vectoriel.

Maîtrise Des Formats

  • JSONL,
  • Parquet,
  • embeddings.

Profil recherché

  • Formation Bac+5 en informatique, IA, Data Science ou équivalent.
  • Expérience significative dans le développement de solutions IA générative.
  • Forte capacité d’analyse, d’innovation et d’industrialisation.
  • Esprit collaboratif et orientation produit.
  • Capacité à travailler dans des environnements cloud et multi-technologies.
  • Atouts complémentaires
  • Expérience sur des projets IA en environnement enterprise.
  • Connaissance des enjeux de sécurité, gouvernance et conformité IA.
  • Expérience DevSecOps ou architecture cloud.
  • Contributions open source ou veille technologique IA.
